LanguageData.CK.Hygiene.TakeShowerDesc: Send this colonist to the nearest shower.
LanguageData.CK.Hygiene.UnblockDesc: Clear this fixture's blocked drain immediately and restore use.
LanguageData.CK.Hygiene.BoilerModeButtonDesc: Click to cycle low/normal/high power. Low power saves electricity but heats less.
LanguageData.CK.Hygiene.ConnectBedDesc: Link this fixture to a bed for private bathroom ownership.
LanguageData.CK.Hygiene.OccupancyRestrictionDesc: When enabled, this fixture counts as occupied while anyone else is in the room.
LanguageData.CK.Hygiene.AllowColonistsDesc: If off, colonists will not use this fixture.
LanguageData.CK.Hygiene.GutBugMessage: {0} caught a gut infection from dirty water or poor hygiene.
LanguageData.CK.Hygiene.Alert.FixtureBlockedDesc: These hygiene fixtures have no water, a blocked drain, no power, or a full pit: {0}
LanguageData.CK.Hygiene.FloatMenu.NoWaterTank: No water tank with free space
LanguageData.CK.Hygiene.TubEmpty: No water left in the tub
LanguageData.CK.Hygiene.AutoRefillDesc: Refills itself from a connected water network. Turn off to rely on rain and manual pouring.
LanguageData.CK.Agriculture.FertilizeDesc: Mark soil for fertilizing. Colonists spend 10 biosolids per cell to raise its fertility.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Module.Hygiene.Name: Shower
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Module.Hygiene.Desc: Hygiene need, shower and hot water; based on DBH.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Module.Storage.Name: Warehouse / stacking
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Module.Storage.Desc: Warehouse and stacking jobs; based on StackXXL.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Module.Robotics.Name: Robotics
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Module.Robotics.Desc: Nanny robot: sweeps, scrubs and hauls automatically; docks to recharge when low.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Module.Localization.Name: Localization
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Module.Localization.Desc: Text replacement and Chinese localization; based on DevMenuChinese.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Module.Rjw.Name: RJW (bundled)
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Module.Rjw.Desc: RJW 1.6 is bundled; do not enable an external RimJobWorld at the same time.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Storage.Hint: Global stack rules and warehouse capacity: before Tier 1 the slider below applies; after Tier 1 the global limit is fixed at ×10. Tier 2/3 only enlarge stacks inside the vertical warehouse. Capacity is counted in stacks.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Storage.Enabled.Desc: Multiplies stackLimit for stackable items; disabling restores vanilla limits.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Storage.Tier1Fixed: Tier 1 is complete: the global limit is fixed at ×10 and this slider no longer applies. Tier 2/3 only affect stacks inside the vertical warehouse.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Storage.WarehouseStac: Stacks each warehouse can hold (default 12, range 1-200). Applies to existing and new warehouses immediately; lowering it never destroys stored items.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Storage.LogChanges.De: Only for compatibility debugging; writes one line per changed Def.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Storage.StackXXLWarn: Stack XXL is also active; this module leaves stack limits untouched to avoid stacking multipliers.
LanguageData.CK.VerticalWarehouse.InternalStacking: Internal stacking: stack limit ×{0} (this building only)
LanguageData.CK.VerticalWarehouse.NoPower: No power; temperature control is off, but storage still works.
LanguageData.CK.VerticalWarehouse.NoConveyor: No conveyor connected; automatic input/output is disabled. Connect a conveyor to one of the four sides.
LanguageData.CK.VerticalWarehouse.AutoConveyorDesc: When enabled, every 250 ticks the first stored stack is placed onto a connected conveyor port.
LanguageData.CK.VerticalWarehouse.ToggleConveyorDesc: Reverse the first centered port conveyor: input or output.
LanguageData.CK.VerticalWarehouse.NoConveyorPort: No centered port conveyor to toggle.
LanguageData.CK.StorageManagement.Title: Storage management
LanguageData.CK.StorageManagement.None: No matching warehouses on this map.
LanguageData.CK.VerticalWarehouse.CollectDesc: Directly stores loose stackable items within 8 cells (prototype helper, not a hauling job).
LanguageData.CK.VerticalWarehouse.WithdrawAllDesc: Drop every stored item next to the building or onto a connected conveyor port.
LanguageData.CK.ConveyorHub.ReverseDesc: Switch the output to the opposite side of the building's facing. Items still enter from any side and move toward the current output.
Only replaces labels in the developer Debug menu; gameplay, Defs and saves are untouched.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Localization.Conflict: DevMenuChinese is also active; both patches process labels, so keeping one is recommended. This module still translates all 34 menu groups.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Localization.NotLoade: Translation table is not loaded; check Translations/DevMenuLabels.xml or click Reload.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Localization.Hint: Dev menus are only visible in developer mode. Reopen the Debug menu after changing schemes; restart after editing the XML table.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Module.Blueprint.Name: Blueprints
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Module.Blueprint.Desc: Capture a finished building layout, rebuild it with the original or currently available materials, and keep reusable templates across saves.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Blueprint.Hint: The blueprint library is saved with each colony. Templates are written to Config/ColonyKit/Blueprints and can be reused across saves.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Blueprint.MaterialMod: Original material: reproduce the captured blueprint. Use what is on hand: keep the source material if stocked, otherwise pick the cheapest stocked material. Cheapest: always pick the cheapest usable material.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Blueprint.MaxSide.Des: Reject captures wider or taller than this many cells.
Reject captures above this count to keep ghost previews responsive.
Delete old blueprints after reaching this limit.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Blueprint.Verbose.Des: Write one log line per capture/placement for troubleshooting.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.Hint: Adjust hygiene and bladder decay, fixture water use, contamination risk, DBH coexistence and need exemptions. After changing policy or exemptions, use "Apply to existing pawns".
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.NeedsRate.Des: 1.00 is default; 0 means hygiene no longer decays naturally.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.BladderRate.D: 1.00 is default; 0 means the bladder no longer fills naturally.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.WaterUse.Desc: Applies to showers, baths, basins and toilets; 1.00 is default.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.HotWaterUse.D: Matches DBH's hot water usage setting; 1.00 is default, higher drains hot water tanks faster.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.Contamination: Multiplier for dirty-water contamination; 100% is default, 0 disables it.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.ShowOverlay.D: Tints fertilized (brown) and irrigated (blue) cells on the ground. Turn off to rely on designations and crop growth only.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.FertilizerStr: Fertility multiplier on fertilized cells; 110% is the DBH default.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.FertilizerFlo: Fertilized cells are raised to at least this fertility; 50% is the DBH default (so poor sand can grow).
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.FertilizerCap: Highest fertility a fertilized cell can reach, irrigation included; 200% by default. Raise for richer soil, lower to rein in the stacking.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.FertilizerLif: Days a single application keeps working; 60 days is the DBH default.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.IrrigationStr: Fertility multiplier on irrigated cells for the day; 180% is the DBH default and multiplies with fertilizer.
When a colonist decides to bathe and a free double bathtub is available, this is the chance they invite an opposite-sex colonist to join; 8% is default, 0% disables invitations.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.Dbh.Policy.De: How this module's hygiene needs and automatic jobs behave when Dubs Bad Hygiene is detected.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.Exemptions.Hi: Lists use defNames separated by commas or semicolons; leave empty for no exemption.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.Prisoners.Des: If off, prisoners receive no hygiene or bladder need from this module.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.Guests.Desc: If off, guests and quest lodgers receive no needs from this module.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.NonHuman.Desc: If off, non-human humanlike body types receive no needs from this module.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.ExemptRaces.D: For example Ratkin, Orassan; empty means no exemption.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.ExemptHediffs: Pawns with any of these hediffs receive no needs from this module.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.Applied: Hygiene needs re-evaluated with the current settings.
